The quotation describes a "Neighbourhood Guarantee" setting minimum service standards for all communities. The specific mechanism is a government-defined floor of public service standards delivered at the local/neighbourhood level. This is about the scope and standards of locally provided public services — fitting H7 (State and Local Government • Intergovernmental Relations) as the primary, since it concerns what residents can expect from their local government. There's also a dimension of H4 (Publicly Provided Goods) since the guarantee concerns the standard of publicly provided services.
